mappings.rationale: The variable AGED directly measures the age at death in days, which is compatible with the concept of age at death.
The variable CIG_REC directly measures cigarette smoking during pregnancy, which is compatible with the concept.
The variable COMBGEST directly measures combined gestation in weeks, which is compatible with the concept of gestational age.
The variable MAGER9 directly measures mother's age recode, which is compatible with the concept of mother's age.
The variable SEX directly measures the sex of the infant, which is compatible with the concept.
The variable UCOD directly measures the underlying cause of death using ICD-10 codes, which is compatible with the concept.
